name: custos_ticket
comment: One row per op of action=pma that changes state (PETITION, PUSH, RELEASE): the request as received, written in the web request; its landing is the job custosLand's, which writes the answer. A later column is a schema update, never a reinterpretation of one of these.

columns.name: ct_id
columns.comment: The ticket: the number POLL takes

columns.name: ct_op
columns.comment: The op's wire word: PETITION, PUSH or RELEASE

columns.name: ct_account
columns.comment: The authenticated account that made the request, its user name

columns.name: ct_request
columns.comment: The request's parameters as received; never parsed by Custos's PHP, read by the Calculator in the job

columns.name: ct_answer
columns.comment: The answer text the job wrote; NULL until DONE

columns.name: ct_done
columns.comment: When the job wrote the answer; NULL until DONE
